originalTitle: ฤดูประหลาด
overview: It all began with a group of university students who came together to form a one-off band for their faculty’s Freshy Night event. Little did anyone imagine that this small band, with the peculiar name “Hoi Jor,” would one day evolve into PARADOX, one of Thailand’s most distinctive music acts. From outcast teenagers who never quite fit in to middle-aged men still holding on to the dreams of their youth, their journey raises a question: What has kept these men, with their vastly different personalities, making music together for more than 30 years, and how have their wonderfully unconventional songs become such familiar and beautiful parts of the soundtrack to generations of people’s lives?
tagline: Because of the strangeness, we got to know each other…
title: Lunatic Summer
